source_checkpoint.question_paraphrase: How far ahead are labor, equipment and power secured for expansion projects?
source_checkpoint.management_paraphrase: Fox-Martin described preordered equipment and interchangeable MK3 components. She first described power as contracted or near contract, then called tracker projects energized; do not treat every site as proven operational.
source_checkpoint.editorial_inference: Audit permitting, executed power agreements, energization and ready-for-service separately; modular equipment can reduce schedule risk without eliminating it.

sources.title: Samsung 2026 Q3 selected main-call Q&A
sources.read_scope: Selected operator attribution, question and management response only

original_issuer_sources.title: Samsung Q3 2026 official regional newsroom release
original_issuer_sources.locator: Group results 73–83; DS segment and outlook 89–98

source_checkpoint.question_paraphrase: What is the memory-supply outlook beyond 2027?
source_checkpoint.management_paraphrase: Management argued that construction and equipment inflation, prepayments, lead times and larger HBM dies limit the translation of CapEx into bits; equipment installation would remain demand-sensitive.
source_checkpoint.editorial_inference: Normalize spending into physical capacity, yield and timing; a tight-supply forecast is management judgment, not verified future output.
